note: Starter policies for a SOC 2 report, written in plain language. Each one says only what most service organisations do; change it to match what you really do before it is approved.

documents.title: System Description
documents.about: The description of the system your CPA firm reviews and publishes in the report. Filled from Scope, Assets and Vendors.

documents.title: Information Security Policy
documents.about: The top-level policy: who is responsible, what every other policy covers, and how they are kept current.

documents.title: Code of Conduct and Acceptable Use Policy
documents.about: How people are expected to behave, and how they may use company systems and data. Everyone signs it.

documents.title: Access Control Policy
documents.about: Who gets access to what, how it is approved, reviewed and removed, and how accounts are protected.

documents.title: Change Management Policy
documents.about: How changes to code, infrastructure and configuration are requested, reviewed, tested, approved and released.

documents.title: Operations and Vulnerability Management Policy
documents.about: Network protection, encryption, malware protection, vulnerability scanning, patching and monitoring.

documents.title: Incident Response Plan
documents.about: How security events are triaged, incidents handled, customers told, and lessons learned.

documents.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
documents.about: Recovery objectives, backups, redundancy, and how recovery is tested.

documents.title: Risk Assessment Policy
documents.about: How risks to the service commitments are found, scored, treated and reviewed, including fraud. The register is filled from Risks.

documents.title: Vendor Management Policy
documents.about: How vendors and subservice organisations are assessed, contracted and reviewed. The list is filled from Vendors.

documents.title: Data Classification and Retention Policy
documents.about: How information is classified and handled, how long it is kept, and how it is destroyed.

documents.title: Security Awareness and Training Policy
documents.about: Background checks, security training at joining and every year, and the training record. Filled from Training.

documents.title: Monitoring and Internal Review Procedure
documents.about: How controls are checked between audits, and how weaknesses are reported and fixed. Filled from Internal audits and Exceptions.
